lane: GPU 2: pooling and heads (G3, then G5)
tests_belief: 7 (std pooling settled); also 9 (localised pooling, added rather than replacing, legible windows)

frozen_F1.what: Per-frame token statistics from the seed-46 recipe A encoder of the fold each row is held out from (OOF encoder, epoch 20, one unflipped view). Head as recipe A (LayerNorm, Linear128, GELU, Linear3, same objective, AdamW 1e-3, batch 16, 20 epochs, schedule 10) fit on the other folds' rows, read on the held-out fold. Three head seeds; each seed read as mean APE over epochs 16-20; arm read as the mean over seeds.
arms_preregistered: quant (std, p1, p5, p25, p50, p75, p95, p99)
cov_sqrt (std, matrix square root of that covariance)
autocorr (std, radial autocorrelation of all 768 channels at lags 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,10 tokens)
spectrum (std, radial power spectrum of 64 PCs, 24 bins)
multiscale (std, std after average pooling at 2,4,8,16 tokens)
localhet (std, mean and sd over windows of within-window std, 16 and 32 tokens)
winhead (std, distribution over 130 ROI-size windows of the trained head output, and head output and std in the two legible windows)
frozen_F1.reference: std, with the same z-scoring and the same head seeds
frozen_F1.folds: 0 and 4 first; five folds for any arm that passes the screen
frozen_F1.ci: paired donor bootstrap on APE across the folds read
frozen_F1.screen_for_end_to_end: two-fold pooled delta <= -0.03, CI below 0, both folds negative. Frozen features come from encoders trained for std, so this is a filter, not a pass.
frozen_F1.pass_new_member: plan rule: two-fold mean <= -0.05, CI below 0, or added to best pipeline <= -0.02, CI below 0
frozen_F1.sanity: stored epoch-20 predictions of each encoder reproduced on its validation rows (median relative difference < 0.002); frozen std head within 0.10 of the member's epochs 16-20 mean, else the encoders are not aligned enough for a cross-fit read and the arm read falls back to same-encoder training rows

frozen_F2_heads.what: Same std features, same read. Heads: HL-Gauss distribution over binned log target with MAPE-optimal decode (weighted median with weights 1/y), and pinball quantile head with the same decode, against the recipe head.

correction_F3.what: Any F1 or F2 arm that passes the screen, on all five folds, as a correction on top of BEST in best_pipeline_20261106.py: H x exp(BEST + c), c from a model fit without that fold's labels.
correction_F3.pass: plan rule: <= -0.01 on the mean, CI below 0, 4 of 5 folds, settings chosen inside training folds

end_to_end_E.what: Arm chosen by F1/F2, trained end to end from SSL5 with the recipe A runner on one GPU, folds 0 and 4, seed 46, paired with phase2_pooling_replication_20261026/f0_s46_std and phase2_pooling_20261020/arms/std.
end_to_end_E.read: mean of epochs 16-20 on each fold, paired, donor bootstrap
end_to_end_E.pass: plan rule: two-fold mean <= -0.05, CI below 0, or added to best pipeline <= -0.02, CI below 0

G5_within_donor.what: source/recipeA_cotwin_1gpu_20261106.py: recipe A with the co-twin term, lam 1, one GPU, micro-batch 4, SSL5, seed 46, folds 0 and 4. Fixes the crash of recipeA_cotwin_20261104.py (row order rearranged inside the loader tripped the runner's order check); the order is now rearranged where the runner draws it.
G5_within_donor.read: mean of epochs 16-20 on each fold, paired on the same frames, donor bootstrap. Secondary, descriptive: CV and HEX per metric; within-pair r of fellow eyes on validation against the reference.
G5_within_donor.passes: plan rule: two-fold mean <= -0.05, CI below 0, or added to best pipeline at w 0.125 or 0.25 <= -0.02, CI below 0. Aim of the idea is CV and HEX, so a CV + HEX gain with CD loss is reported as such but does not change the gate.

amendments.why: The first frozen std read failed its own sanity check (fold 0 9.50 against member 9.11). Diagnosis on fold 0, one seed: global per-channel z-score 9.47, per-encoder z-score 9.50, raw std 9.18. So encoder alignment was not the cause; z-scoring low-variance channels was. No arm had been read at that point.
amendments.what: F1 v2: each high-dimensional block keeps its raw scale and gets its own LayerNorm, as the recipe does for std; outputs are concatenated before Linear128. skew and kurtosis are signed-log transformed; winstat and legible_pred (few, unlike units) are z-scored on training rows without LayerNorm. Sanity, screen and pass rules unchanged. Added F1b: ridge on whitened PCs of each block against the honest residual of BEST, all five folds, number of PCs and penalty chosen per metric by inner folds on training rows; read with best_pipeline under the correction rule. Results in reads/v2/.

amendments.why: F1 v2 sanity, measured against the member's epochs 16-20 mean as the gate says: fold 0 frozen std 9.193 against 9.081 (+0.112), fold 4 9.146 against 9.012 (+0.134). Both miss the 0.10 limit, so the fallback applies.
amendments.what: F1 own (primary for the screen, folds 0 and 4): each fold's encoder runs on all rows, head fit on that encoder's training rows, read on its validation rows. Same head, seeds, reference and gate. Training rows are in-sample for that encoder, as they were for the member's own head. The cross-fit F1 v2 and F1b keep running as secondary evidence and are reported with that label.

amendments.why: F1 own finished with no arm through the screen. The screen is a filter with a known bias (encoders trained for std) whose size was never measured. Results were seen before this amendment.
amendments.what: Calibration, descriptive, cannot pass anything: frozen own read of mean alone against std on folds 0 and 4, compared with already trained end-to-end arms, last five epochs (phase2_pooling_20261020/arms fold 4 seed 46; replication f0_s47 and f4_s47). Adaptation credit = frozen delta of mean minus end-to-end delta of mean.
amendments.decision_rule: Credit >= 0.08 (the size of the known mean-against-std effect): the frozen screen cannot close pooling, so one second-order or spatial arm goes end to end on folds 0 and 4 although it failed the screen, labelled as such; plan pass rule unchanged. Credit < 0.08: pooling is closed on this encoder and the GPU goes to something else after co-twin.
amendments.arm_choice: Lowest added-to-best at w 0.25 with CI below 0 among std+autocorr, std+cov_sqrt, std+spectrum and the combinations read here (std+autocorr+cov_sqrt, std+autocorr+spectrum). Ties within 0.003 go to the arm covering both second-order and spatial statistics, because one run then settles both.
amendments.also: F1b rest: selection bug fixed for blocks with fewer dims than the smallest K; legible_pred, legible_std, cls read under the same correction rule. HEX-only read of the saved F1b corrections is exploratory, because the metric was chosen after seeing outer folds; it can be reported but cannot pass.

amendments.why: Calibration result under the rule written before it ran. Frozen own mean against std: +0.122 pooled (fold 0 +0.089, fold 4 +0.155). Trained mean against std, last five epochs: fold 0 seed 47 +0.120, fold 4 seed 46 +0.049, fold 4 seed 47 +0.051; pooled on one seed per fold +0.085. Credit 0.037, below 0.08.
amendments.what: The frozen screen stands. No second-order or spatial arm goes end to end; pooling on this encoder is closed. mean_std agrees as well: frozen fold 4 +0.027, trained fold 4 seed 46 +0.032.

amendments.why: Instruction from the coordinating session: co-twin fold 0 read 9.185 against 9.081, no frozen arm passed, so cancel co-twin fold 4 and run strong-view SSL with a second seed.
amendments.what: Co-twin chain stopped by pid before fold 4 started; fold 0 finishes, is audited and read on its own. GPU 2 then runs lane GPU 1's arm cropopt_both end to end at regression seed 47.
amendments.root_change: Lane GPU 1's run_e2e.sh refuses e2e/cropopt_both_f4/f4_s47 because that wrapper test root has a frozen manifest. So source/run_e2e_gpu2_20261107.sh is a copy with one path changed: root is this lane's e2e/<arm>/f<fold>_s<seed>. It also refuses to start unless the arm's SSL has rc 0 in lane GPU 1's done.tsv.
amendments.invalid_run: The queue fell through to fold 0 seed 47 after that failure and started it from lane GPU 1's SSL at epoch 1 of 5. Stopped after one update. Its root is renamed INVALID_partial_ssl_f0_s47_20261107; it holds no result to read.

strong_view_seed47.what: Recipe A from the arm's encoder (SSL seed 1003, crop + broad optics views, mean and std pooled in SSL), regression seed 47, one GPU, std pooling, 20 epochs, fold 4 then fold 0.
strong_view_seed47.reference: phase2_pooling_replication_20261026/f4_s47_std and f0_s47_std, same regression seed, SSL5 encoder
strong_view_seed47.read: mean of epochs 16-20 on each fold, paired, donor bootstrap
strong_view_seed47.pass: plan rule: two-fold mean <= -0.05, CI below 0, or added to best pipeline at w 0.125 or 0.25 <= -0.02, CI below 0. Lane GPU 1 reads its seed 46 runs under the same rule.
